summary: Orchestra BioMed Holdings, Inc. filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for a marketed follow-on offering of 15,000,000 common shares at $5.00 per share, raising $75.0M gross ($70.5M net before expenses) against a November 5, 2026 last sale of $5.62, implying an approximately 11% discount. Underwriters Piper Sandler, TD Cowen, BTIG and H.C. Wainwright received $0.30 per share discounts and hold a 30-day option for 2,250,000 additional shares. Settlement is expected on or about November 9, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and post-deal overhang.
